subtitle.zh: Rhino × Grasshopper × Processing × ComfyUI 协同设计
subtitle.en: A design workflow connecting Rhino, Grasshopper, Processing, and ComfyUI

description.zh: 将参数化模型转化为可交互的点云，并通过生成式影像演化为不断变化的多元宇宙。
description.en: Parametric geometry becomes an interactive point cloud and evolves through generative moving images into a changing multiverse.

kind.zh: 参数化空间／创意编程／生成影像
kind.en: Parametric space / Creative coding / Generative film

coverAlt.zh: 深色宇宙中彩色粒子与生长轨迹围绕概念模型扩散。
coverAlt.en: Coloured particles and growing trails spread around a conceptual model in a dark cosmos.

role.zh: 参数化建模、交互编程与生成影像设计
role.en: Parametric modelling, interaction programming, and generative image design

stage.zh: 概念模型、粒子交互与生成影像
stage.en: Conceptual model, particle interaction, and generative film

deliverables.zh: 参数化分析、Rhino 模型、Processing 粒子交互、ComfyUI 工作流与动态影像
deliverables.en: Parametric studies, Rhino model, Processing particle interaction, ComfyUI workflows, and moving images

overview.zh: 以多元宇宙与未来世界观为起点，将参数化几何、粒子交互和生成式影像连接为一条连续的创作路径。通过生物形态与机械结构的组合，构建一个由不同时间线相互支撑、不断生长和变化的混合生态空间。
overview.en: Beginning with multiverses and future worldviews, this project links parametric geometry, particle interaction, and generative moving images. Organic forms and mechanical structures combine into a hybrid ecology, where possible timelines support one another and continually grow and transform.
